[cf S. dabhnoti; cf also S. druhyati (and dhūrvati?)], injures, hurts (+ acc., gen. or loc.); deceives, betrays; Dhātup 213 (dubha jigiṃsāyaṃ); Dhātum 309 (dubha jigiṃsane); Vin II 203,12* (aduṭṭhassa hi yo ~e, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr ~o) = It 86,9*; S I 84,.15 (kiñcāpi kho myāyaṃ rājā māgadho Ajātasattu vedehiputto adubbhantassa ~ati atha ca pana me bhāgineyyo hoti); 225,.10 (yo me assa paccatthiko tassa pāhaṃ na ~eyyan ti); Th 1129 (na nūna maṃ ~issasi punappunaṃ, Ee, Se so; Be, Ce nanu maṃ …); Ja II 54,.2 (yathā sappo tayi na ~ati evāhaṃ akāsiṃ); III 192,24* (evaṃ ce maṃ viharantaṃ Subāhu samma ~asi; 193,4´ : ~asi hanituṃ icchasi); 212,.27 (ahaṃ mahārāja tayi na ~āmi tvaṃ pana maṃ mārehī ti tassa hatthe asiṃ ṭhapesi); IV 262,19* (na tv evāhaṃ ruruṃ ~e; 262,23´ : na tv eva ahaṃ … ~issāmi); V 72,11* (kuṭṭhī kilāsī bhavati yo mittānaṃ idha ~ati, Ee so; Be mittānidha ~ati; Ce, Se mittānaṃ idha dubbhī; 74,23´ : yo idha imasmiṃ loke mittānaṃ ~ati hiṃsati, Ee so; Ce, Se idha loke; Be idha loke mittāni); 487,8* (taṃ tādisaṃ pubbakiccaṃ saranto ~e ahaṃ tassa kathaṃ janinda); 503,30* (na jātu ~ema imassa rañño); VI 14,7* (bahū naṃ upajīvanti yo mittānaṃ na ~ati, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee dūbhati; cf Sadd 695,.20 : keci pana na dūhatī ti paṭhanti); 491,8* (na cāhaṃ tassa ~eyyaṃ, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se tasmiṃ); Ps III 329,.15 (Ahiṃsakamāṇavo tumhākaṃ antare ~atī ti); — part.pr. (a) dubbha(t), dūbha(t) mfn., Ja IV 261,14* (yo ~ato mānusassa na dubbhi, Be, Ce so; Ee dūbhato; Se dubbhino); (b) neg. adubbhanta, mfn., S I 84,.16; (c) neg. adubbhamāna, mfn., Ja IV 274,22´; — aor. 3 sg. dubbhi, Ja III 13,.15 (amacco rājantepure ~i); 2 sg. dubbhi, Ja VI 310,1* (mā c’ assu mittesu kadāci ~i, Se so; Be dubbhī; Ce, Ee dūbhī); Th-a III 158,.7; 2 pl. dubbhittha, dubbhittho, Ja V 72,10* (māssu mittānaṃ ~ittho); 245,.29 (tumhe pi kumārā mā rañño ~itthā ti); — inf. dubbhituṃ, Ja II 125,.19 (attano upakāresu sevakesu piyāsu ca itthīsu ~ituṃ na sakkā ti); VI 140,5* (tesaṃ pi tādisānaṃ icchanti ~ituṃ mahārāja); — absol. dubbhitvā, Ja IV 79,.26 (antepure ~itvā); — fpp (a) dubbheyya, mfn., Ja V 71,17* (~eyyaṃ maṃ amaññatha; 73,24´ : ~eyyan ti ~itabbaṃ vadhitabbaṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee dūbheyyan ti dūbbhitabbaṃ …); (b) dubbhitabba, mfn. and n., impers., Ja V 73,24´; 87,21* (tasmā hi mittānaṃ na ~itabbaṃ).

duvāra n.m., and ~ā, f. [S. dvāra, n.], 1. a door; a doorway, an entrance; a passage; Abh 219 (~aṃ ca paṭihāro); 1110 (paṭihāre mukhe ~aṃ); Vin II 220,.5 foll. (chabbaggiyā bhikkhū jantāghare … aggiṃ datvā ~aṃ thaketvā ~e nisīdanti); III 38,.36 (kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ divāvihāragato ~aṃ vivaritvā nipanno hoti); Pv 19:6 (pidahitvā ~aṃ bhuñjāmi mā maṃ yācanakāddasuṃ, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be bhuñjiṃ); Ja I 150,.12 (migagaṇaṃ uyyānaṃ pavesetvā ~aṃ pidhāya); 346,30´ foll. (~āni pidahanto sabbadvāresu sūcighaṭikādayo datvā sattamaṃ talaṃ abhiruhitvā tattha pi ~aṃ pidahitvā nisīdi); VI 441,5* (aggiṃ ~ato dema; 441,8´ : ~aṃ pidahitvā tattha aggiṃ dema); 524,.25 (so gehe dubbalaṭṭhānaṃ thiraṃ katvā ~aṃ paṭisaṅkharitvā); Ap 90,.28 (sobhayanto mama ~aṃ kapparukkho patiṭṭhati); Vism 41,.12 (bhagavatā ~aṃ dinnaṃ tasmā vaṭṭatī ti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se duvāram); Sp 299,.28 (yaṃ pana ~e ṭhito mātugāmo bhājanadhovana-udakaṃ chaḍḍeti); 1122,.3 (sītasamaye ~aṃ ca vātapānaṃ ca supidahitaṃ kātabbaṃ); Ps III 220,.23 (tassā guhāya ~e pilakkharukkho ahosi); Sadd 425,.19 foll. (dvaranti saṃvaranti rakkhanti etenā ti ~aṃ, atha vā dve kavāṭā aranti gacchanti pavattanti etthā ti ~an ti … pāḷiyan tu ~ā ~an ti ca itthinapuṃsakavasena °-saddo vutto tathā hi ~aṃ pi surakkhitaṃ hotī ti ca ~ā p’ esā ti ca tassa dviliṅgatā vuttā); — ifc see agga- (sv agga1), apāruta- (sv apāpurati), āṇi-, giri-, culla- (sv culla1), pure-, mahā- (sv maha[t]); — 2. a gate of a town, a gateway; Vin I 230,.7 (yen’ ajja samaṇo Gotamo ~ena nikkhamissati taṃ Gotamadvāraṃ nāma bhavissati); D II 83,.16 (ye kho keci oḷārikā pāṇā imaṃ nagaraṃ pavisanti vā nikkhamanti vā sabbe te iminā va ~ena pavisanti vā nikkhamanti vā ti); S I 58,.9 (catusu ~esu dānaṃ dīyittha); A II 241,.16 (dakkhiṇena ~ena nikkhāmetvā dakkhiṇato nagarassa sīsaṃ chindissanti); Ja IV 4,10* (sabbe apihitā ~ā); VI 276,4* (aṭṭālake ca ~e ca maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ); Ap 240,.14 (dakkhiṇamhi duvāramhi); 599,.13 (~ena Haṃsavatiyā Gaṅgā sandati sabbadā); Mil 58,.5 (°-ttā); Mhv 5:47 (dakkhiṇena duvārena pavisitvā); — 3. a door as a means of access; a way, a means; Vin I 7,4* (apārutā tesam amatassa ~ā; Sp 963,.17 : amatassa ~ā ti ariyamaggo, so hi amatasaṅkhātassa nibbānassa ~aṃ); Ja I 366,27* (atthassa ~ā pamukhā chaḷ ete; 367,15´ : vaḍḍhisaṅkhātassa … atthassa ete pamukhā uttamā cha ~ā upāyā adhigamamukhānī ti); VI 229,9* (n’ atthi ~aṃ sugatiyā); 373,14* (atthassa ~āni avāpuranto); — esp. the sense-organs and the mind, as means of access for experience; It 24,10* (cakkhu sotaṃ ca ghānaṃ ca jivhā kāyo tathā mano etāni yassa ~āni suguttāni ’dha bhikkhuno); Th 125 (makkaṭo pañcadvārāyaṃ kuṭikāyaṃ … ~ena anupariyeti); Dhs 597 (cakkhuṃ p’ etaṃ … loko p’ eso ~ā p’ esā samuddo p’ eso …);
